sloka: अद्य मे सफलम् तप्तम् स्वर्गः चैव भविष्यति ।त्वयि देव वरे राम पूजिते पुरुषर्षभ ॥३-७४-१२॥
transliteration: adya me saphalam taptam svargaḥ caiva bhaviṣyati ।tvayi deva vare rāma pūjite puruṣarṣabha ॥3-74-12॥

translations.english: O best of men, O highest of the gods my birth has become fruitful today with your worship, (you have made) even attainment of heaven quite certain.
